select id, user_name, user_code from mes_msg_user
deleted_flag = '0'
and id = #{id}
and (user_name like concat('%', #{userName}, '%') or user_code like concat('%', #{userName}, '%'))

select u.id, u.user_name, u.user_code, u.gender, u.id_card, u.phone_number, u.birthday, u.lunar_birthday, u.email, u.sms_notify_flag, u.email_notify_flag, u.father_id, f.user_name as fatherName, f.user_code as fatherCode, u.mother_id, m.user_name as motherName, m.user_code as motherCode, u.spouse_id, s.user_name as spouseName, s.user_code as spouseCode from mes_msg_user u left join mes_msg_user f on u.father_id = f.id and f.deleted_flag = '0' left join mes_msg_user m on u.mother_id = m.id and m.deleted_flag = '0' left join mes_msg_user s on u.spouse_id = s.id and s.deleted_flag = '0'
u.deleted_flag = '0'
and u.id = #{param.id}
and u.user_name like concat('%', #{param.userName}, '%')
and u.user_code like concat('%', #{param.userCode}, '%')
and u.phone_number like concat('%', #{param.phoneNumber}, '%')
order by u.update_time desc
